data.label: Vital Statistics Governed Record
data.description: A vital statistics record. The governed record: the data cluster, the PROV activity and agent and the audit event from the ProvGov library by identifier, and the digital signature proof. Members: Vital Event; prov-activity (Provgov); prov-agent (Provgov); audit-event (Provgov); Digital Signature Proof.

items.label: Digital Signature Proof
items.description: Cryptographic proof of attestation (digital signature)

items.label: Audit Event
items.description: A logged access or custody event as data: what was done, by whom, on what, with what outcome and for what purpose. The audit-only case of sdc5 issue 002; state-changing operations are workflow transitions.

items.label: Audit Agent Reference
items.description: The acting agent (FHIR AuditEvent.agent.who). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Audit Entity Reference
items.description: The entity the event concerns (FHIR AuditEvent.entity.what). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Audit Event Identifier
items.description: The identifier of the audit event.

items.label: Data Subject Reference
items.description: The data subject or patient the event concerns (FHIR AuditEvent.patient; SDC DM.subject). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: On Behalf Of Reference
items.description: The party on whose behalf the agent acted (FHIR agent.onBehalfOf; prov:actedOnBehalfOf). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: System Identifier
items.description: The system that handled the item (FHIR AuditEvent.source.observer; SDC AuditType.system-id).

items.label: System Location Name
items.description: The site or facility that handled the item (FHIR AuditEvent.agent.location; prov:atLocation).

items.label: Audit Event Action
items.description: The operation performed in a logged access event (FHIR AuditEvent.action). Read and Execute change no state and are audit facts, not workflow moves.

items.label: Audit Event Outcome
items.description: The result of an audited event (FHIR AuditEvent.outcome).

items.label: Confidentiality
items.description: The level of protection the information requires (HL7 v3 Confidentiality). At assembly the value populates a component's act tag.

items.label: Provenance Agent Type
items.description: The functional role of an agent in an activity (FHIR Provenance.agent.type).

items.label: Purpose of Use
items.description: Why the information was used (HL7 v3 ActReason purpose of use). Activity context, not an access-control tag.

items.label: Audit Recorded At
items.description: When the audit event was recorded (FHIR AuditEvent.recorded).

items.label: PROV Activity
items.description: A PROV activity: what it was, when it ran, its status, and the entities, activities, agent and plan it relates to.

items.label: Activity Description
items.description: A description of what the activity does and why.

items.label: Activity Identifier
items.description: The identifier of a PROV activity: a URI or another globally unique identifier.

items.label: Activity Label
items.description: A human-readable label for a PROV activity.

items.label: Activity Location
items.description: Where the activity took place (prov:atLocation), as text.

items.label: Activity Type
items.description: The kind of activity, in the vocabulary of the domain (prov:type).

items.label: Error Message
items.description: The error the activity reported, if it failed.

items.label: Had Plan Reference
items.description: The plan the activity followed (prov:hadPlan). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Used Entity Reference
items.description: An entity the activity used (prov:used). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Associated With Reference
items.description: The agent associated with the activity (prov:wasAssociatedWith). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Ended By Reference
items.description: The entity that ended the activity (prov:wasEndedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Informed By Reference
items.description: An activity that informed this one (prov:wasInformedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Started By Reference
items.description: The entity that started the activity (prov:wasStartedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Activity Status
items.description: The state of an activity, from the Data Privacy Vocabulary activity status concepts.

items.label: Ended At
items.description: When the activity ended (prov:endedAtTime).

items.label: Started At
items.description: When the activity started (prov:startedAtTime).

items.label: PROV Agent
items.description: A PROV agent: a person, organization or software agent, with its identity, contact and delegation.

items.label: Acted On Behalf Of Reference
items.description: The agent on whose behalf this agent acted (prov:actedOnBehalfOf). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Agent Description
items.description: A description of the agent and its responsibilities.

items.label: Agent Email
items.description: The agent's email address (foaf:mbox).

items.label: Agent Identifier
items.description: The identifier of a PROV agent: a URI or another globally unique identifier.

items.label: Agent Name
items.description: The name of the agent (foaf:name).

items.label: Agent Organization Name
items.description: The organization the agent belongs to or is.

items.label: Software Name
items.description: The name of a software agent.

items.label: Software Version
items.description: The version of a software agent.

items.label: PROV Agent Type
items.description: The kind of PROV agent: person, organization or software agent.

items.label: Vital Event
items.description: A vital event registered in the Republic of Cordova: certificate number, event type, event and registration dates, city, province, record status, and the birth, death, marriage or divorce record. Members: Certificate Number; Event Type; Event Date; Registration Date; City; Province; Record Status; Birth Record; Death Record; Marriage Record; Divorce Record.

items.label: Certificate Number
items.description: Unique certificate number for this vital record

items.label: City
items.description: One of the nine cities in the Republic of Cordova.

items.label: Event Type
items.description: Type of vital event (XdToken)

items.label: Province
items.description: One of the three provinces of the Republic of Cordova. Used across civil registry, property, tax, and all geographic records.

items.label: Record Status
items.description: Status of the vital record

items.label: Event Date
items.description: Date the vital event occurred

items.label: Registration Date
items.description: Date the business was officially registered in Cordova

items.label: Birth Record
items.description: A registered birth: the child's national ID and NIEM person name (Default full name by identifier), the birth date, sex as recorded and the birth facility. Members: National ID (CID); person-name (NIEM); date-of-birth (Default); sex-recorded (Default); Birth Facility.

items.label: Birth Facility
items.description: Name of the hospital or facility where birth occurred

items.label: National ID (CID)
items.description: Cordova National Identity Number. Format: COR-PPCC-NNNNNN where PP is the two-letter province code (AL=Aldara, BR=Brevina, CE=Celara), CC is the two-digit city code (01-03), and NNNNNN is a six-digit sequence number. Issued at birth or naturalization. Required for all government transactions.

items.label: Sex (Recorded)
items.description: The sex of a person as recorded, distinct from administrative gender.

items.label: Date of Birth
items.description: The date a person was born.

items.label: Person Name (NIEM)
items.description: A data type for a combination of names and/or titles by which a person is known. NIEM 6.0 nc:PersonNameType. Members: full-name-person (Default); Person Name Category Code; Person Maiden Name; Person Preferred Name; Person Official Given Name; Person Sur Name Prefix; Person Name Salutation; Effective Date.

items.label: Person Maiden Name
items.description: An original last name or surname of a person before changed by marriage. NIEM 6.0 nc:PersonMaidenName.

items.label: Person Name Salutation
items.description: A formal sign or expression of greeting that is appropriate for this person. NIEM 6.0 nc:PersonNameSalutationText.

items.label: Person Official Given Name
items.description: A name, out of possibly multiple given names, that a person selects to use as his or her official given name. NIEM 6.0 nc:PersonOfficialGivenName.

items.label: Person Preferred Name
items.description: A name by which this person prefers to be known. NIEM 6.0 nc:PersonPreferredName.

items.label: Person Sur Name Prefix
items.description: A prefix that precedes this person's family name such as Van, Von. NIEM 6.0 nc:PersonSurNamePrefixText.

items.label: Person Name Category Code
items.description: A kind of person name. NIEM 6.0 nc:PersonNameCategoryCode. Codes of nc:PersonNameCategoryCodeSimpleType (4 values).

items.label: Effective Date
items.description: A date that information take effect. NIEM 6.0 nc:EffectiveDate.

items.label: Full Name (Person)
items.description: The parts of a person's name and how the name is used.

items.label: Given Name (Person)
items.description: The name given to a person at birth or naming, distinguishing them from others in the same family. Also called first name or forename.

items.label: Middle Name (Person)
items.description: An additional given name, placed between the first given name and the surname.

items.label: Name Prefix
items.description: An honorific or title placed before a person's name, such as Mr., Ms., Dr. or Prof.

items.label: Name Suffix
items.description: A suffix placed after a person's name, such as Jr., Sr., III, PhD, MD or Esq.

items.label: Surname (Person)
items.description: The family name of a person, shared with other members of the family. Also called last name or family name.

items.label: Name Use
items.description: The purpose or context of a person's name.

items.label: Death Record
items.description: A registered death: the national ID, the NIEM person name, the death date (NIEM), the cause of death as a FHIR ICD-10-CM coded value, and the manner and place of death. Members: National ID (CID); person-name (NIEM); person-death-date (NIEM); diagnosis-icd10cm (FHIR); Manner of Death; Place of Death.

items.label: Manner of Death
items.description: Manner in which death occurred

items.label: Place of Death
items.description: Type of location where death occurred

items.label: Person Death Date
items.description: A date a person died or was declared legally dead. NIEM 6.0 nc:PersonDeathDate.

items.label: Diagnosis (ICD-10-CM)
items.description: The condition, problem or diagnosis. A coded value: the ICD-10-CM code, its display text and the fixed code system, resolved on the code system IRI (FHIR Coding). FHIR Condition.code.

items.label: Code System: ICD-10-CM
items.description: The code system of a coded value, fixed: ICD-10-CM (http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10-cm). FHIR Coding.system.

items.label: Code Display Text
items.description: The human-readable display of a coded value, as recorded with the code (FHIR Coding.display).

items.label: Diagnosis Code (ICD-10-CM)
items.description: The ICD-10-CM code for the condition, problem or diagnosis. FHIR Condition.code, coded in http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10-cm.

items.label: Divorce Record
items.description: A registered divorce: a party's national ID and NIEM person name, the marriage certificate it dissolves and the decree date. Members: National ID (CID); person-name (NIEM); Marriage Certificate Number; Decree Date.

items.label: Marriage Certificate Number
items.description: Certificate number of the original marriage being dissolved

items.label: Decree Date
items.description: Date the divorce decree was issued by the court

items.label: Marriage Record
items.description: A registered marriage: a party's national ID and NIEM person name, the certificate number and the officiant's title. Members: National ID (CID); person-name (NIEM); Marriage Certificate Number; Officiant Title.

items.label: Officiant Title
items.description: Title or capacity of the officiant (e.g., "Judge", "Minister", "Civil Registrar")
